list.delete_confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? It will be removed from the list and its canvas will no longer open.

form.desc_too_long: Description must be at most 2000 characters

list.load_failed_hint: Please retry; if it keeps failing, contact your organization administrator.
list.unauthorized_hint: Your account or the active organization no longer has access to workflows. Switch organization or ask an administrator to grant access — retrying will not help.
list.no_workflows_hint: Click "New Workflow" to create your first workflow

unbound.title: Workflow space not initialized yet
unbound.description: This organization has no workflow space yet, so the workflow list is unavailable. Click the button below to initialize it — the space name is taken from your organization name, there is nothing to fill in, and clicking again simply returns the existing space.

degraded.title: Upstream not ready
degraded.description: The workflow app bound to this organization is marked unavailable upstream, so workflows cannot be read right now. Contact an administrator, then retry.

list.initialize_failed: Could not initialize the workflow space. Please retry; if it keeps failing, contact your organization administrator.
list.initialize_failed_session: The platform workflow account is unavailable right now, so initialization did not finish. Please retry later or contact your organization administrator.
list.initialize_failed_upstream: The upstream service is temporarily unavailable and initialization did not finish. Please retry later.
list.initialize_failed_unauthorized: This session is not allowed to initialize a workflow space. Sign in again, then retry.

delete_refused.reviewing: This workflow is under first-release review and cannot be deleted yet. Check the review result in the canvas, then retry.
delete_refused.unpublish_required: This workflow must be unpublished in the canvas before it can be deleted.
delete_refused.unknown: The upstream service does not allow deleting this workflow right now. Check its release state in the canvas, then retry.

timeout.title: Canvas initialization timed out
timeout.description: The canvas did not finish initializing within 10 seconds. The upstream service may be busy or the network slow. Please retry.

loadFailed.title: Canvas failed to load
loadFailed.description: The canvas page could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry.

handshakeFailed.title: Canvas session could not be established
handshakeFailed.description: Access credentials were not delivered to the canvas, so the workflow was not opened. Please retry.

canvasError.title: Canvas error
canvasError.description: The canvas reported an internal error and editing cannot continue.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.description: The canvas credentials expired and cannot be renewed. Sign in again and reopen the workflow from the list.

unbound.title: Workflow space not initialized yet
unbound.description: This organization has no workflow space yet, so the canvas cannot be opened. Initialize it on the workflow list page, then retry.

degraded.title: Upstream not ready
degraded.description: The workflow app bound to this organization is marked unavailable upstream, so the canvas cannot be opened right now. Contact an administrator, then retry.

spaceMissing.title: Upstream not ready
spaceMissing.description: The platform workflow account's space is still initializing, so the canvas cannot be opened yet. This page retries automatically in a moment; if it keeps failing, contact your organization administrator.

probeFailed.title: Upstream state unknown
probeFailed.description: Reading the tenant binding or platform account failed, so the canvas was not opened. Please retry.

publish.failed_unauthorized: This session is not allowed to publish this workflow. Sign in again, then retry.
publish.failed_not_found: This workflow no longer exists in the workflow space. Refresh the list, then retry.
publish.failed_unbound: This organization has no workflow space yet. Initialize it on the list page first.
publish.failed_degraded: The workflow app bound to this organization is marked unavailable upstream, so publishing is not possible right now. Contact an administrator, then retry.
publish.failed_session: The platform workflow account is unavailable right now and the publish did not finish. Please retry later or contact your organization administrator.
publish.failed_draft_not_verified: The current draft has not passed a test run yet. Run it once in the canvas, then publish.
publish.failed_version_not_incremental: The version number is not strictly increasing: the locally recorded version is behind upstream (usually because a publish happened inside the canvas). Check the version in the canvas, then retry.
publish.failed_version_invalid: The locally recorded publish version is invalid. Fix that record before publishing.
publish.failed_timeout: The upstream service timed out, so the publish result is unknown. Check "Log" later to confirm the actual state before retrying.
publish.failed_upstream: The upstream service rejected this publish. Please retry later; if it keeps failing, check the release state in the canvas.

log.title: Log · {{name}}
log.description: Both the publish records and the current version come from the upstream workflow engine; the platform keeps no publish log.
log.failed_hint: The publish records and current version could not be read from upstream. Please retry later.
log.empty_hint: The upstream workflow engine returned no publish record for this workflow (records are maintained upstream and never generated by the platform).
log.drift_hint: The locally recorded version differs from upstream: while it lags behind, the next publish is rejected upstream as "not self-incrementing". Treat the state shown in the canvas as authoritative.
log.drift_match: The locally recorded version matches upstream.
